content: Wappalyzer fingerprints tech via HTTP response headers (Server/X-Powered-By reveal web server or CDN like Cloudflare/Akamai/CloudFront), HTML patterns (meta generator tag e.g WordPress version, HTML comments, DOM structure), JS asset paths (/wp-content/ = WordPress, /_next/ = Next.js), global JS variables (window.__NUXT__), and distinctively named cookies. Uses a large regex-based fingerprint database matched against these signals, open source (github.com/wappalyzer forks after original went closed-source).
